description: Engrave Pants - Lacerate 3 sec cast Requires Druid Requires level 1 Requires Pants Engrave your pants with the Lacerate rune: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 50 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.
